meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Runs maximum-saturation research with a cooperating team, claim-graph gating, and a cited, QA'd deliverable. Use when the user explicitly asks for research or a deep investigation, including any 'ulw' research wording.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发起一次深度调研,拿到一份带引用、经过质检的研究报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要就一个陌生领域查大量资料并整理出可信结论。
copy.tagline_en: Run a deep investigation and get back a cited, quality-checked research report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often dig through many sources on a new topic and need a citable result.

howto.what: 它会组建一支研究团队，把主题拆成多条线索并行搜集资料、互相辩论、用代码验证有争议的结论，最后交出一份每条结论都带引用或证明的综述，并留下可追溯的会话记录。
howto.when: 只有当你明确要求做研究、深度调查，或提到 “ulw-research”、“ulw” 研究、ultradebate 等措辞时才触发；普通提问不会启用。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 给我彻底研究一下这个主题
对这个话题做 ultradebate 研究，争议结论跑代码验证
say.note: 争议结论会至少过一轮辩论或验证

say.text: 对这份已有报告做 ulw 深挖，补齐每条结论的引用
say.note: 会先判断报告是未完成还是已完成再决定续写

howto.what_en: It stands up a research team to scope the topic, fan out over sources along several axes, debate and cross-critique findings, prove contested claims by running code, and deliver a synthesis in which every claim carries a citation or a proof, plus an auditable session journal.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when you explicitly ask for research or a deep investigation, or use wording such as ulw-research, ulw research, or ultradebate. Ordinary questions are answered normally.

say_en.text: Run ulw-research to investigate this topic exhaustively
say_en.note: Prints ULW-RESEARCH MODE ENABLED! then splits research axes

say_en.text: Do an ultradebate research pass on this, verify contested claims in code
say_en.note: Contested claims get a debate round or code proof

say_en.text: Deep-dive this existing report with ulw and add citations to every claim
say_en.note: First checks whether the report is partial or complete
